raw.title: Data Engineer (Fully Remote)
raw.excerpt: The Role We NeedPadSplit is growing its analytics platform and needs a hands-on Data Engineer to work alongside our existing DE lead.
raw.description:
The Role We Need

PadSplit is growing its analytics platform and needs a hands-on Data Engineer to work alongside our existing DE lead. This person will build and maintain ingestion and transformation pipelines across Dagster (or Airflow), dbt, and Snowflake, with supporting work in Python, Airbyte, and AWS. The role combines building new pipelines and data models with providing real coverage on critical paths — especially the daily Postgres → Snowflake → dbt flow and third-party API loads — all shipped through reviewed pull requests rather than one-off scripts.

The Person We Are Looking For

We're looking for a practitioner who thinks natively in dimensions, facts, and slowly changing dimensions — someone who knows when to use a full refresh versus an incremental load and how that choice affects idempotency and backfills. This person writes clear, reviewable PRs and gives equally thoughtful reviews, with attention to scoped diffs, sensible tests, and failure modes. They're comfortable in complex Python data flows and have enough AWS literacy to reason about task roles, buckets, and cross-account access without needing to own all of platform engineering.

Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day:

  • PR-driven shipping: Opening and merging pull requests for new or updated Dagster jobs, assets, schedules, and sensors, plus dbt models, tests, and documentation.
  • Infrastructure tweaks: Writing occasional Terraform for secrets, environment variables, or job sizing when a pipeline needs it.
  • Pipeline implementation: Building and debugging Python pipelines covering REST/API syncs, large Postgres extracts, Parquet loads, and Snowflake COPY operations.
  • Airbyte management: Configuring or troubleshooting Airbyte connections wherever managed sync is the right fit.
  • Production monitoring: Watching production runs and investigating failures related to IAM, OOM, Spot instances, or bad watermarks.
  • Backfills & catch-ups: Running backfills and incremental catch-ups with a clear story for what landed and why.
  • Modeling partnership: Working with analytics and product on dim/fct/x_fct design, incremental strategies, and data quality.
  • Code review & runbooks: Participating in code review, release prep, and writing short runbooks so others can operate your pipelines when you're out.

Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful:

  • Warehouse fundamentals: Solid grasp of relational databases and warehouse patterns — keys, grain, normalization vs. star schema, and how SCD behavior gets encoded.
  • Orchestration experience: Practical, hands-on Dagster (or Airflow) experience — not just writing SQL inside a scheduler UI.
  • dbt proficiency: Real experience building and maintaining models, tests, and documentation in dbt.
  • Python at scale: Comfort reading and writing Python that moves data at scale across extract, transform, and load steps.
  • AWS working knowledge: Practical familiarity with S3, IAM, and ECS/Fargate at a "debug my job" level.
  • EL tool familiarity: Experience with Airbyte or similar extract-and-load tools.
  • PR discipline: The discipline to write pull requests others can easily review, and to give equally rigorous reviews in return.
  • Reliability mindset: A track record of keeping pipelines healthy and modeling consistent across full refresh and incremental paths, without becoming a single point of failure.

The Interview Process:

  • Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by a real human being from the PeopleOps team.
  • If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a video interview with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.
  • If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Principal Data Scientist for forty-five (45) minutes.
  • If warranted, the next step would be a video panel interview with key stakeholders at PadSplit for one and a half (1.5) hours.
  • If warranted, the next and final step would be a video interview with a key leader in the company for thirty (30) minutes.
  • If warranted, we move to offer!

Compensation, Benefits, and Perks:

  • Fully remote position - we swear!
  • Competitive compensation package including an equity incentive plan and company-wide bonus opportunity
  • National medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans
  • Company provided life insurance policy
  • Optional accidental insurances, FSA, and DCFSA benefits
  • Unlimited paid-time (PTO) policy with eleven (11) company-observed holidays
  • 401(k) plan
  • Twelve (12) weeks of paid time off for both birth and non-birth parents
  • The opportunity to do what you love at a company that is at the forefront of solving the affordable housing crisis

Please note: Although the job posting says it's in Atlanta, Georgia, this is a fully remote position. This is a result of our Applicant Tracking System requiring a location to post the role on LinkedIn.

Notice to Applicants:

PadSplit participates in E-Verify. All new employees are required to complete an I-9 form and be authorized to work in the United States. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of the E-Verify process.
PadSplit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

raw.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

As Legal Counsel, you’ll help Alpaca navigate complex regulatory frameworks as we design and launch innovative financial products and services. You’ll provide practical, business-oriented legal guidance across U.S. broker-dealer regulation, digital assets, payments, and other evolving areas of financial services.
You’ll partner closely with teams across Product, Brokerage, Crypto, Compliance, AML, Sales, and Success, supporting everything from product and regulatory reviews to agreements, policies, regulatory engagement, and disputes. This is a highly cross-functional role with the opportunity to help shape how Alpaca scales in a fast-moving regulatory environment.

Job Responsibilities
  • Navigate complex regulatory frameworks to help the business design and implement innovative financial products and services.
  • Lead legal reviews of product design, marketing, and customer onboarding processes to ensure compliance with applicable regulations while enabling business growth.
  • Support other areas of the business, such as digital assets, payments, and data privacy, as needed.
  • Advise on the application of new or anticipated legal requirements and regulatory guidance to the firm’s systems, policies, and procedures.
  • Monitor regulatory developments at relevant governmental agencies and self-regulatory organizations, including the SEC, FINRA, CFTC, FinCEN, and OFAC.
  • Support the company’s engagement with regulators, including the SEC, FINRA, and other agencies.
  • Draft agreements, disclosures, policies, and procedures.
  • Conduct legal research and analysis on novel questions and provide clear, practical guidance to internal stakeholders.
  • Manage litigation, arbitration, and other disputes, including developing case strategy, coordinating with outside counsel, responding to claims and discovery, and advising the business on risk and resolution options.
  • Partner cross-functionally with teams outside of Legal, including the firm’s Product, Brokerage, Crypto, Compliance, Anti-Money Laundering, Sales, and Success functions.

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • J.D. degree (or foreign equivalent) and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • 5-7+ years of legal experience, with at least 3 years focused on U.S. broker-dealer regulation, including the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, regulations and rules thereunder, FINRA rules, and other federal and state securities laws.
  • Familiarity with U.S. cryptoasset regulatory regimes, including the SEC, CFTC, NYDFS, FinCEN, and AML requirements.
  • Strong experience advising fintechs or financial institutions, ideally in a startup or growth-stage environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver strategic, business-oriented legal advice under tight deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a practical, collaborative working style.
  • Strong judgment, self-motivation, and the ability to work independently and manage multiple projects.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a growth mindset in a fast-scaling company.

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

raw.description:
Kyverna Therapeutics is a patient-centered, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing cell therapies for patients suffering from autoimmune diseases. Guided by our core values, Stay True to Why, Collaborate to Accelerate, Lead with Clarity, Boldly Innovative, and Own the Outcome, we are committed to transforming the future of treatment for autoimmune disease. Join us at the forefront of cell therapy innovation and help redefine what’s possible.

Position Overview

Kyverna is seeking Medical Science Liaison (MSL)/Senior Medical Science Liaison (MSL) to join the Medical Affairs organization. The MSL will serve as a field-based scientific expert supporting external engagement with healthcare professionals, investigators, treatment centers, and key opinion leaders (KOLs) focused on autoimmune diseases and cell therapy.

The ideal candidate will bring strong scientific expertise, exceptional relationship-building skills, and experience supporting complex specialty therapies within biotechnology or pharmaceutical environments. This individual will play a critical role in communicating scientific and clinical data, gathering field insights, and supporting the continued development of Kyverna’s CAR-T therapy programs.

Location: Remote ideally based SoCal, AZ, NV, UT,

Travel: Approximately 50-70%

Responsibilities

  • Scientific Engagement & KOL Management
    • Identify, establish, and maintain high‑quality scientific relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), investigators, academic medical centers, community physicians, pharmacists, nurses, and treatment centers within the assigned territory.
    • Serve as a trusted scientific partner by providing fair‑balanced, accurate, and compliant scientific exchange related to disease state, treatment landscape, Kyverna’s CAR‑T programs, and emerging clinical data.
    • Act as a primary scientific liaison to investigators interested in clinical research collaborations and investigator‑initiated research discussions, in alignment with company policies.
    • Territory Strategy & Field Medical Planning
      • Develop and execute geography‑specific Medical Affairs and KOL engagement plans aligned with therapeutic area objectives, investigator needs, and Kyverna’s medical strategy.
      • Demonstrate ownership of the assigned territory through stakeholder mapping, prioritization, and proactive planning to influence the patient journey and support optimal therapeutic decision‑making.
      • Partner with other Kyverna field medical colleagues to share insights and coordinate external engagement approaches where appropriate.
      • Clinical Development & Trial Support
        • Collaborate with Clinical Development and Clinical Operations colleagues to support Kyverna‑sponsored clinical trials, including:
        • Identification of potential trial sites
        • Engagement with participating investigators
        • Support of trial awareness and scientific dialogue
        • Contribute to efforts aimed at enhancing trial feasibility and enrollment through appropriate scientific engagement with investigators and treatment centers.
        • Medical Insights & Internal Collaboration
          • Capture and communicate timely, high‑quality medical insights related to the autoimmune and cell therapy landscape to internal stakeholders to support strategy and evidence planning.
          • Translate external scientific perspectives into actionable insights that inform medical, clinical, and development decision‑making.
          • Collaborate cross‑functionally with Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Commercial, Market Access, and Patient Services teams while maintaining strict non‑promotional boundaries.
          • Scientific Representation & Compliance
            • Provide scientific support at national, regional, and local congresses, advisory boards, investigator meetings, and medical education forums.
            • Respond compliantly to unsolicited medical information requests and serve as an internal and external scientific resource.
            • Maintain current knowledge of therapeutic areas, treatment guidelines, clinical research processes, and cell therapy operational considerations, including treatment center workflows where applicable.
            • Ensure timely completion of CRM documentation, administrative tasks, required training, and pharmacovigilance responsibilities, including adverse event and product complaint reporting.
            • Conduct all activities in full compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.

Qualifications

    • Advanced scientific or clinical degree required (MD, PharmD, PhD, DNP, NP, PA, or equivalent).
    • Medical Science Liaison (MSL) requires Doctorate degree OR Master’s degree & 3 years of Medical Affairs experience
    • Senior Medical Science Liaison (Senior MSL) requires Doctorate degree & 2 years of Medical Affairs experience OR Master’s degree & 6 years of Medical Affairs experience
    • Prior experience in cell therapy, CAR-T, immunology, rheumatology, nephrology, neurology, hematology/oncology, or rare diseases strongly preferred.
    • Strong understanding of clinical trial design, clinical development, and medical affairs functions.
    • Experience engaging with academic medical centers, specialty treatment centers, and/or infusion centers preferred.
    • Ability to interpret and communicate complex scientific and clinical information to diverse audiences.
    • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
    • Demonstrated ability to build strong external relationships and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
    • Comfortable operating within a fast-paced, high-growth biotechnology environment.
    • Willingness and ability to travel extensively within assigned geography.
    • Experience supporting pre-commercial or launch-stage biotechnology organizations.
    • Knowledge of autoimmune disease treatment landscapes and emerging cell therapy approaches.
    • Experience supporting investigator-sponsored research and clinical trial recruitment initiatives.
    • Familiarity with cell therapy operational concepts including chain of identity, chain of custody, and treatment center workflows.

For MSL the national salary range for this position is from $170,000 to $185,000 USD annually.

For Sr. MSL the national salary range for this position is from $190,000 to $210,000 USD annually.

This salary range is an estimate of what we reasonably expect to pay for this posted position, and the actual salary may vary based on various factors, including without limitation individual education, experience, tenure, skills and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. This position is also eligible for bonus, benefits, and participation in Company’s stock plan.

raw.description:
Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients.

We're looking for a Senior Director / VP, Customer Support to elevate customer service as a strategic lever for product excellence. This is not a traditional support leadership role—you'll own the end-to-end system that captures, routes, resolves, and learns from every support case, driving both immediate service quality and long-term case prevention through product roadmap influence.

You'll build and scale a new generation of technically-oriented support professionals, create career paths that retain top talent, and establish the operational rigor that scales with our growth. As a key partner to Product and Engineering leadership, you'll translate support insights into product improvements that prevent issues at the source.

If you see customer service as a product to be engineered, love building high-performing organizations, and want to shape how a healthcare technology company serves its customers, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Drive Operational Excellence & Service Delivery

  • Own SLA and case-resolution performance for the entire support organization, delivering on time-to-resolution, backlog reduction, and customer satisfaction targets
  • Build a high-functioning system, team, and operating model that exemplifies exceptional customer service standards
  • Design and audit the QA framework for AI-assisted case resolution—ensuring teams critically evaluate AI output and maintain quality over speed
  • Continuously optimize case triage, routing, and escalation systems, including seamless handoff processes to Product Development
  • Establish business operating procedures for all product support resolution, including monitoring, root cause analysis, and analytics
  • Report performance metrics to the CPO and cross-functional leadership, making support performance transparent and actionable

Build & Scale the Organization

  • Redefine the support hiring profile toward a materially more technical standard: professionals who resolve complex issues, reason about underlying systems, discern AI quality, and actively improve support operations for team-wide leverage
  • Build a credible in-function career ladder with clear levels, competitive compensation, and senior technical leadership roles that create real growth paths
  • Manage and develop Support Managers, instilling a high-performance culture with clear accountability, coaching rigor, and team development
  • Own training, enablement, and onboarding infrastructure that brings new hires to technical proficiency rapidly
  • Scale the team strategically while improving operational leverage—absorbing growth without proportional cost increases

Partner Cross-Functionally & Influence Product Direction

  • Own the case-to-roadmap feedback loop: translate support data into prioritized, evidence-backed recommendations that prevent future cases at the source
  • Partner closely with Product Leadership on roadmap prioritization decisions that materially impact case volume—acting as a strategic partner in product direction
  • Ensure customer feedback via support plays a critical role in the product development lifecycle
  • Collaborate with Customer Operations leadership to ensure holistic service standards across onboarding, customer success, and support

Engineer Systems for Scale

  • Treat support as a tunable system: continuously analyze the full case journey and engineer improvements to throughput, quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction
  • Own workforce planning, capacity modeling, tooling investments, and the long-term operating model as case volume and product complexity scale
  • Build data infrastructure and dashboards that make support performance visible and actionable for stakeholders

What Success Looks Like

Short Term (First Year)

  • SLA performance consistently meets or exceeds targets
  • Case volume per active provider trending down through product-driven prevention
  • New technical support profile defined, hired, and successfully embedded in Product Development teams
  • In-function career ladder designed, communicated, and first promotions executed
  • Case-to-roadmap feedback loop established with measurable impact on Product backlog prioritization

Long Term

  • Support scales with greater operating leverage while maintaining or improving service quality
  • Top performers advancing through the career ladder; retention of high performers at 90%+
  • AI-assisted case resolution quality at 95%+ accuracy with strong human oversight
  • Support recognized internally as a strategic product partner and driver of product excellence

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • 7+ years building or scaling technical support/TSE organizations, or 5+ years building and scaling consumer product services at software or SaaS companies with genuine tiered escalation models and technical depth
  • Proven track record running functions against hard SLAs and systematically improving them—not just maintaining baseline performance
  • Deep people management experience: Built strong teams, culture, and outcomes; developed high-performing teams through coaching, leadership, and accountability
  • Experience building or redesigning support career ladders and leveling frameworks that retain technical talent

Technical & Strategic Capabilities

  • Technically credible: You may have an engineering background but chose an operations/people-leadership path; you can speak engineer-to-engineer and assess technical problem-solving quality
  • Systems thinker: You see support as an end-to-end process to optimize, not just a service desk to staff; you've built or redesigned workflows, tooling, and operational models
  • Data-driven: You translate metrics into insights and insights into action; you've used case data to drive product roadmap prioritization
  • Proven ability to partner with Product and Engineering leadership as a peer—you've influenced roadmaps, secured resources, and navigated matrix structures
  • Lean Six Sigma or Process Engineering experience is a plus

Leadership & Culture

  • Customer Service as a Product mentality: You design for plans that anticipate problems before customers encounter them, treating support cases as trust-building moments rather than liabilities to manage
  • Builder mentality: You've started functions from scratch or led major transformations; you're energized by ambiguity and building the playbook
  • High standards with high empathy: You hold teams accountable to excellence while investing in their development and growth. You genuinely care about your people
  • Cross-functional influence: You've driven outcomes through partnership and evidence when you don't control all the levers

Salary range: $180,000-250,000

We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. raw.description:
BlackCloak’s mission is to protect corporate executives and high-profile individuals in their personal lives, mitigating risks to their families, companies, reputation, and finances. We defend our clients’ digital lives from hackers, privacy leaks, and identity theft. If you are passionate about helping to protect others, then keep reading - this may be your next great opportunity.

BlackCloak is seeking a seasoned and highly skilled Senior Incident Responder to join our Technical Success Team. This is a senior, client-facing individual contributor role for someone who has spent years on both sides of the problem: the technical compromise of computers, phones, and online accounts, and the financial fraud that so often follows it. In this critical role, you will serve as the primary escalation point and lead investigator for complex security events; taking ownership of the full incident response lifecycle, from initial triage and containment through eradication, recovery, and post-incident reporting.

Our clients are executives, board members, and high-profile individuals whose personal accounts and devices are targeted precisely because their corporate ones are hard to breach. When something goes wrong in a client's personal digital life, you are the person who takes the call, works the incident end to end, and stays with them until it is resolved. You will also help us get better at preventing the next one: mapping how each incident unfolded against both the cyber attack kill chain and the personal attack kill chain, closing the gaps that made it possible, and mentoring the responders behind you.

If you excel at guiding clients through high-stress situations, possess deep technical expertise in digital forensics, and have a proven track record of handling sophisticated threats targeting high-profile individuals, this is an opportunity to elevate your career and make a tangible impact.

What You Will Do

    • Execute End-to-End Incident Response: Lead comprehensive incident handling consistent with core IR principles (NIST/SANS) from the initial client request and triage through containment, recovery, and post-incident lessons learned.

    • Investigate Complex Compromises & Targeted Attacks: Manage and remediate severe client security incidents, including but not limited to, compromised email ecosystems, SIM swap attacks, financial account takeovers, and targeted credential harvesting.

    • Device Analysis: Conduct analysis on client computers and mobile devices to assess the scope of compromise and implement effective remediation strategies.

    • Remediate Fraud & Identity Theft: Analyze and assess account activity and transaction records available to the client on their email, banking, retail, and social platforms to help establish what occurred, and support clients in their conversations with the platforms on fraud investigations, disputes, account freezes, etc.. Guide identity theft victims through the remediation process - credit bureau freezes and fraud alerts, IdentityTheft.gov and law enforcement reporting - and advise clients on the activity they should watch for and report back to the team.

    • Map the Attack Chain: Map observed activity against the personal attack kill chain - from data-broker reconnaissance and social engineering of the client's inner circle through device compromise, account takeover, and financial monetization - to identify the likely stage of an attack and the actions that break the chain, focusing on technique and exposure rather than actor attribution.

    • Provide White-Glove Client Support: Interface directly with clients and, where authorized, their families and support staff - assistants, family office, corporate security - during high-stakes emergency onboardings and active incidents, providing calm, clear, and authoritative guidance while communicating complex threat assessments.

    • Participate in On-Call Rotation: Serve in an on-call and escalation rotation that requires occasional nights and weekends to address client incidents, emergency onboardings, and time-sensitive issues.

    • Lead & Mentor: Serve as the highest technical escalation point in the on-call rotation, while actively mentoring Security and Client Success team members to elevate the team's overall technical proficiency.

    • Enhance Security Posture: Oversee network vulnerability scans of client infrastructure, proactively refine internal IR playbooks, and conduct periodic post-onboarding touchpoints.


      • Note: This role requires occasional nights and weekends to address emergency client incidents.

What You Need to be Successful

    • 5-8+ years of experience in a dedicated Incident Response, Digital Forensics (DFIR), or advanced cybersecurity analyst role.

    • Proven track record executing the full incident lifecycle, particularly involving personal/executive account takeovers, mobile threats, and endpoint malware.

    • Demonstrated experience investigating fraud in financial transactions, including direct coordination with banks and credit card companies - fraud investigation, disputes and chargebacks, transaction analysis, or account takeover response. This may have been gained at a financial institution, card issuer, payment processor, fintech risk team, financial crimes unit, or in a security role working these cases directly.

    • Deep technical expertise conducting forensics and vulnerability management across Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and Linux ecosystems.

    • Working command of identity theft remediation and attack kill chain models, with the ability to apply them to an individual and their family rather than an enterprise network.

    • Advanced industry certifications are highly preferred (e.g., GCIH, GCFA, CISSP, OSCP, or similar); fraud and financial crime credentials such as CFE, CFCS, or CAMS are a strong plus.

    • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate technical jargon into actionable advice for non-technical clients, maintaining deep empathy and composure during high-stress crises.

    • College degree in an Information Technology (IT/CS/CE) discipline or equivalent real-world experience, coupled with the ability to operate highly independently.

BlackCloak is an extremely fast-growing company in an entirely new product category. We have amazing product fit validated by industry awards and an impressive client base of Fortune 500 companies across all industries.

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Who You Are

You are a Senior Network and Security architect who will build and operate the Networking & Security managed service in collaboration with the Networking & Security Practice Manager, Principal Architect, and Managed Services team, owning the operational build-and-run of a service designed to grow and scale.

About The Role

The Managed Services Enterprise Architect bridges strategic security architecture with hands-on managed services delivery, ensuring that both the design and ongoing operation of network and security systems meet client needs, regulatory requirements, and performance SLAs. It requires a blend of technical expertise, operational management, and client relationship skills.

Must be based in the United States. Travel up to 30% may be required.

Other responsibilities include:

  • Implement event management, dynamic monitoring, observability, and predictive monitoring / AIOps.
  • Author operational runbooks and automation to run the service repeatably.
  • Government or enterprise security experience is advantageous.
  • Deep knowledge of networking principles, TCP/IP, firewalls, IDS/IPS, authentication, and general networking.
  • Experience with NSX, cloud security, and secure configuration management.
  • Proficiency in cyber-attack response, threat detection, and risk-based controls.
  • Leadership and mentoring abilities.
  • Strong customer-facing and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-client environment.
  • Design and implement secure network architectures, including cloud hosting, operating system hardening, and integration of security tooling.
  • Develop and maintain firewall/IPS rules, test new security products, and review application/system security controls.
  • Create network diagrams, flowcharts, and documentation for all security products and procedures.
  • Collaborate with network systems teams to remediate infected systems and support secure network operations.
  • Lead and mentor technical teams, providing oversight of budget, contract milestones, and SLA compliance.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve security alerts, manage customer expectations, and deliver executive-level reporting.
  • Develop training modules and materials for new and existing security personnel.
  • Coordinate with sales, pre-sales, and product teams to deliver solutions, integrate clients into managed services, and evaluate cybersecurity solution performance.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for clients, validating Statements of Work and ensuring service delivery against contracts.
  • Manage and monitor customer security devices remotely.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve storage and network configuration issues in collaboration with vSphere administrators.
  • Use SIEM tools (e.g., Splunk, ArcSight) for monitoring, analysis, and reporting.
  • Apply cyber-attack defense techniques and threat detection to protect enterprise environments.

Desired skills and experience:

  • 10 to 15 years in network and security managed-services operations
  • Strong operational competencies across monitoring and observability, automation, incident and change management, and cost management.
  • Proven experience operating networking environments supporting production, mission-critical workloads.
  • Strong understanding of AWS, Azure, & GCP networking and connectivity models.
  • Excellent communication and customer service management skills, including the ability to run service reviews with customer leadership.
  • Experience integrating AI into service offerings, building or leveraging AI/ML platforms to resolve tickets, surface optimization opportunities, and drive AIOps, is a major plus.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field preferred.
  • Experience within a Managed Services Provider (MSP) environment.
  • General familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001, and a security-aware approach to operations (security policies, event logging, awareness training).
  • Deep familiarity with Palo Alto firewall environments
  • Certifications in one of the following: CISSP, CEH, GIAC, CISA, CCNP, CCIE, CCNA, SANS, ITIL, PMP preferred.

A Little About Us

Our mission is to challenge and enable our employees to achieve great things.

We live and breathe our core values:

raw.excerpt: Senior Competitive & Market Intelligence ManagerWEKA is the AI data and memory infrastructure company transforming how organizations build, run, and scale AI.
raw.description:
Senior Competitive & Market Intelligence Manager

WEKA is the AI data and memory infrastructure company transforming how organizations build, run, and scale AI. NeuralMesh™ combines high-performance data storage and extended GPU memory in a single software platform, providing a foundation for training, inference, and agentic AI workloads that maximizes GPU productivity, accelerates AI outcomes, and improves the economics of AI at scale.

WEKA is a pre-IPO, growth-stage company backed by world-class venture capital investors and AI infrastructure leaders. Our technology is trusted by 30% of the Fortune 50, as well as leading hyperscalers, neoclouds, AI builders, and research organizations. Our team is customer-obsessed, accountable, bold, and collaborative, with a shared focus on helping customers succeed. If we sound like your kind of people, join us!

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Competitive & Market Intelligence Manager to build and lead the intelligence capability that helps us understand where the market is going, how competitors are evolving, where WEKA has the right to win, and what we need to do about it.

This is a technical, hands-on builder role. You will design and scale the systems, tools, operating rhythms, and feedback loops that turn fragmented competitive, customer, field, and market signals into a trusted intelligence engine for the company. You'll go deep on competitors and market dynamics, develop clear points of view, and translate what you learn into positioning, competitive deal strategies, field tools, technical briefs, training decks, product insights, and recommendations that help WEKA stay ahead in a fast-moving AI infrastructure market.

Reporting to the VP of Product Marketing, you'll work closely with Product, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, Alliances, GTM Operations, and executive leadership. You'll serve as a trusted source of intelligence across the company, helping teams understand not simply what is changing, but what it means for WEKA and what we should do next.

Who We’re Looking For

You're a senior builder. You've created or materially scaled a competitive or market intelligence capability before, and you understand everything required to make it work: sources, tools, processes, field feedback loops, operating cadence, executive communication, enablement, and measurement. You're comfortable starting with a blank page, deciding what matters, and building a system people actually trust and use.

You're intellectually curious, analytical, and technical enough to go well beyond competitor websites and marketing claims. You can dig into products, architectures, benchmarks, customer experiences, business models, and go-to-market strategies, separate signal from noise, and develop a defensible point of view about where competitors are strong, where they're vulnerable, and where the market is headed.

You also know intelligence only matters if it changes decisions and outcomes. You can turn deep research into a concise executive recommendation, a sharp competitive position, or a field tool a seller can use in a live deal. You stay close to Sales, Product, customers, and the market, and measure success by better decisions and stronger competitive performance, not the volume of research produced.

What You’ll Be Working On

  • Build the Intelligence Engine: Design and scale WEKA's competitive and market intelligence program, including sources, tooling, workflows, taxonomy, operating cadence, governance, distribution, and feedback loops. Create a trusted system of record that stays current as the market evolves.
  • Own Competitive Intelligence: Develop deep intelligence on priority competitors across products, architecture, performance, positioning, customers, partnerships, business models, and go-to-market strategy. Identify strengths, vulnerabilities, strategic moves, and likely next steps.
  • Monitor Competitive Pricing & Packaging: Track competitor pricing, packaging, licensing, consumption models, and commercial changes, and surface meaningful shifts to Product and other stakeholders to inform pricing and packaging decisions.
  • Drive Market Intelligence: Track the forces reshaping AI infrastructure, including technology shifts, market structure, customer requirements, emerging categories and competitors, cloud and neocloud dynamics, ecosystem moves, business models, and buying patterns. Translate those signals into implications and opportunities for WEKA.
  • Turn Intelligence Into Strategy: Synthesize competitive, market, customer, and field signals into clear points of view and actionable recommendations that inform company positioning, product strategy, go-to-market priorities, category strategy, and where WEKA should invest, defend, or differentiate.
  • Create Competitive Positioning & Tools: Develop and continuously improve competitive positioning, battlecards, playbooks, objection handling, comparison frameworks, executive briefs, and other tools that help Sales, Solutions Engineering, partners, and Marketing differentiate WEKA and win.
  • Build the Field Intelligence Loop: Establish scalable ways to capture what sellers, SEs, partners, prospects, and customers are seeing in the market. Partner with Sales and GTM Operations to turn competitive deal data, field feedback, and win/loss insights into intelligence that improves positioning, enablement, and strategy.
  • Support Competitive Deals: Engage directly with Sales and Solutions Engineering on strategic competitive opportunities, helping teams understand the competitor, sharpen the strategy, respond to claims, and apply what is learned back into the broader intelligence program.
  • Deliver Executive Intelligence: Establish a consistent cadence of concise, decision-oriented competitive and market briefings for Product, GTM, and executive leadership, surfacing meaningful changes, emerging threats and opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Apply AI & Automation: Use AI, automation, and modern intelligence tools to continuously monitor market signals, accelerate research and synthesis, and deliver intelligence in the workflows where teams need it. Apply strong judgment to ensure automation increases signal rather than noise.
  • Influence Product & Marketing: Partner closely with Product and Product Marketing to bring competitive and market insights into roadmap discussions, positioning and messaging, launches, category strategy, campaigns, and thought leadership.
  • Leverage Analyst & Industry Insights: Work with Analyst Relations and other external intelligence sources to incorporate analyst research, industry perspectives, market data, and third-party validation into WEKA's view of the market and competitive landscape.
  • Measure Impact: Establish practical measures of success including intelligence adoption, field engagement, competitive win/loss trends, effectiveness of competitive plays, and demonstrated influence on product, positioning, and GTM decisions.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in competitive intelligence, market intelligence, product marketing, product strategy, management consulting, industry research, or a closely related role in enterprise technology.
  • Demonstrated experience personally building or materially scaling a competitive or market intelligence program, including the systems, tools, processes, operating cadence, and feedback loops required to make it sustainable. We are looking for someone who has built the muscle, not simply participated in an established program.
  • Strong experience conducting competitive research and analysis and translating complex findings into clear positioning, recommendations, enablement, and executive-level insights.
  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to independently understand enterprise infrastructure architectures, product capabilities, performance claims, integrations, and technical differentiation.
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML infrastructure, accelerated computing, cloud computing, data platforms, storage and memory technologies, or adjacent enterprise infrastructure technologies.
  • Experience building field intelligence and win/loss programs, working directly with Sales, Solutions Engineering, customers, and GTM Operations to understand real-world competitive dynamics.
  • Strong primary and secondary research skills with the ability to synthesize product research, customer and field feedback, analyst research, market data, public information, and other signals into a clear point of view.
  • Exceptional written, visual, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to move from deep analysis to concise battlecards, executive briefings, presentations, and strategic recommendations.
  • Experience using AI, automation, and competitive or market intelligence tools to improve the speed, scale, and quality of intelligence programs.
  • Proven ability to influence Product, Sales, Marketing, and executive stakeholders without direct authority and turn intelligence into action.
  • Strong business judgment and an outcome-oriented mindset, with the ability to prioritize the competitors, market questions, and intelligence work most likely to influence customers, strategy, pipeline, and revenue.
  • Comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with significant autonomy and evolving priorities.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical or business field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Located in North America with the ability to travel up to 25%.

How We Work: The WEKA Way

  • We are Accountable: We take full ownership, always, even when things don't go as planned. We lead with integrity, show up with responsibility and ownership, and hold ourselves and each other to the highest standards.
  • We are Brave: We question the status quo, push boundaries, and take smart risks when needed. We welcome challenges and embrace debates as opportunities for growth, turning courage into fuel for innovation.
  • We are Collaborative: True collaboration isn't only about working together. It's about lifting one another up to succeed collectively. We are team-oriented and communicate with empathy and respect. We challenge each other, resolve conflict constructively, and are transparent about our goals and the results we achieve. Together, we're unstoppable.
  • We are Customer Centric: Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We actively listen and prioritize their success, and every decision we make is driven by how we can better serve, support, and empower them to succeed. When our customers win, we win.

Concerned you don’t meet every qualification? Don’t let it stop you from applying!

Studies have shown that traditionally underrepresented groups may be less likely to apply for jobs if they don’t meet every qualification specified. WEKA is committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you are excited about this position but are concerned your past work experience doesn’t match up perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles at WEKA.

WEKA is an equal opportunity employer that prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Overview

The Finance Manager is the senior finance partner to CES regional and operational leadership. The role converts financial and operational data into decisions that improve revenue quality, gross margin, operating expense discipline, and EBIT. It leads the financial cadence for an assigned portfolio of clients, programs, and sites, while directing the work of Operations Analysts and coordinating with Workforce Management, Accounting, Pricing, Commercial, and other enabling teams.

Responsibilities

Regional Financial Leadership

  • Own the regional financial narrative through EBIT, including actuals, forecast, budget, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions.
  • Lead financial performance reviews with regional, site, and program leaders, focusing discussion on business drivers and decisions.
  • Translate operating performance into financial outcomes across revenue, labor, delivery costs, gross margin, operating expense, and EBIT.
  • Maintain a balanced portfolio view and prioritize finance support according to revenue, complexity, margin risk, client commitments, and strategic importance

Planning, Forecasting, and Decision Support

  • Lead the regional annual plan, rolling forecast, long-range outlook, and scenario analysis in partnership with operating leaders
  • Challenge assumptions using operational drivers, historical performance, contractual economics, pipeline changes, inflation, foreign exchange, and site-level cost dynamics.
  • Ensure risks and opportunities have quantified financial impact, accountable owners, specific actions, and expected realization dates.

Client and Commercial Finance

  • Partner with Commercial, Pricing, and Operations on renewals, scope changes, minimum commitments, and margin improvement opportunities.
  • Escalate structural issues in pricing, contractual terms, billing mechanics, or delivery design that could prevent achievement of financial commitments.

Team Leadership and Governance

  • Set priorities, allocate portfolios, coach, and review the work of assigned Operations Analysts; maintain backup coverage for critical programs and billing cycles.
  • Establish consistent standards for forecasts, variance explanations, management reporting, invoicing controls, data quality, and stakeholder follow-through.
  • Coordinate with Workforce Management to ensure staffing, productivity, scheduling, and capacity inputs are timely and financially coherent.
  • Partner with Accounting on close quality, accruals, revenue recognition inputs, cost classification, reconciliations, and resolution of recurring data issues.
  • Maintain documented approvals for invoicing, journal-entry support, forecast changes, and financially significant assumptions.

AI, Automation, and Data Enablement

  • Sponsor standardized, scalable reporting and analysis across the regional portfolio; eliminate lowvalue manual work where controls can be preserved or improved.
  • Partner with the Automation Analyst to prioritize use cases, define requirements, validate outputs, and measure adoption and realized value.
  • Use AI-assisted analysis for anomaly detection, driver identification, scenario generation, and management narratives while retaining human review, source traceability, confidentiality, and financial control.
  • Promote self-service insights for operational stakeholders and ensure that automated outputs lead to clear decisions and actions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field; advanced degree or CPA/CMA credential preferred.
  • Typically 7–10 years of progressive finance, FP&A, commercial finance, or operational finance experience, including leadership of analysts or cross-functional workstreams.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a multi-client or multi-site P&L and the ability to explain performance from revenue through EBIT.
  • Strong planning, forecasting, scenario modeling, business case, and executive communication capabilities.
  • Experience in BPO, contact center, outsourced services, or another labor-intensive service environment strongly preferred.
  • Advanced spreadsheet and business-intelligence capability; practical experience improving finance processes through automation, analytics, or AI-enabled tools.

  • Conduct code reviews with customers, guiding secure coding practices using Checkmarx output
  • Document best practices, lessons learned, workarounds, and feature/defect requests for internal teams
  • Continuously build deep expertise across Checkmarx and integrated technologies

Requirements

Requirements:

  • 3+ yrs software dev experience (Java, .NET, Python, or Mobile)
  • Can read/understand code at first sight
  • Experience with dev infra tools (source control, build servers, bug tracking)
  • Customer-facing technical engagement experience
  • Fluent English + Spanish (written/spoken); Portuguese a plus
  • Experience delivering technical training
  • Experience designing/implementing solutions per customer technical requirements
  • AppSec background (pentesting, code review) — strong plus
  • Degree preferred; Master's/CISSP a plus
  • Time zone: CST (Americas), standard business hours only

Checkmarx offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, competitive compensation, a strong work-life balance, and year-round perks. Checkmarx is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.

raw.title: MANAGER, FINANCE
raw.excerpt: OverviewThe Finance Manager is the senior finance partner to CES regional and operational leadership.
raw.description:
Overview

The Finance Manager is the senior finance partner to CES regional and operational leadership. The role converts financial and operational data into decisions that improve revenue quality, gross margin, operating expense discipline, and EBIT. It leads the financial cadence for an assigned portfolio of clients, programs, and sites, while directing the work of Operations Analysts and coordinating with Workforce Management, Accounting, Pricing, Commercial, and other enabling teams.

Responsibilities

Regional Financial Leadership

  • Own the regional financial narrative through EBIT, including actuals, forecast, budget, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions.
  • Lead financial performance reviews with regional, site, and program leaders, focusing discussion on business drivers and decisions.
  • Translate operating performance into financial outcomes across revenue, labor, delivery costs, gross margin, operating expense, and EBIT.
  • Maintain a balanced portfolio view and prioritize finance support according to revenue, complexity, margin risk, client commitments, and strategic importance

Planning, Forecasting, and Decision Support

  • Lead the regional annual plan, rolling forecast, long-range outlook, and scenario analysis in partnership with operating leaders
  • Challenge assumptions using operational drivers, historical performance, contractual economics, pipeline changes, inflation, foreign exchange, and site-level cost dynamics.
  • Ensure risks and opportunities have quantified financial impact, accountable owners, specific actions, and expected realization dates.

Client and Commercial Finance

  • Partner with Commercial, Pricing, and Operations on renewals, scope changes, minimum commitments, and margin improvement opportunities.
  • Escalate structural issues in pricing, contractual terms, billing mechanics, or delivery design that could prevent achievement of financial commitments.

Team Leadership and Governance

  • Set priorities, allocate portfolios, coach, and review the work of assigned Operations Analysts; maintain backup coverage for critical programs and billing cycles.
  • Establish consistent standards for forecasts, variance explanations, management reporting, invoicing controls, data quality, and stakeholder follow-through.
  • Coordinate with Workforce Management to ensure staffing, productivity, scheduling, and capacity inputs are timely and financially coherent.
  • Partner with Accounting on close quality, accruals, revenue recognition inputs, cost classification, reconciliations, and resolution of recurring data issues.
  • Maintain documented approvals for invoicing, journal-entry support, forecast changes, and financially significant assumptions.

AI, Automation, and Data Enablement

  • Sponsor standardized, scalable reporting and analysis across the regional portfolio; eliminate lowvalue manual work where controls can be preserved or improved.
  • Partner with the Automation Analyst to prioritize use cases, define requirements, validate outputs, and measure adoption and realized value.
  • Use AI-assisted analysis for anomaly detection, driver identification, scenario generation, and management narratives while retaining human review, source traceability, confidentiality, and financial control.
  • Promote self-service insights for operational stakeholders and ensure that automated outputs lead to clear decisions and actions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field; advanced degree or CPA/CMA credential preferred.
  • Typically 7–10 years of progressive finance, FP&A, commercial finance, or operational finance experience, including leadership of analysts or cross-functional workstreams.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a multi-client or multi-site P&L and the ability to explain performance from revenue through EBIT.
  • Strong planning, forecasting, scenario modeling, business case, and executive communication capabilities.
  • Experience in BPO, contact center, outsourced services, or another labor-intensive service environment strongly preferred.
  • Advanced spreadsheet and business-intelligence capability; practical experience improving finance processes through automation, analytics, or AI-enabled tools.

LOCATION

Remote Work-at-Home

POSITION OVERVIEW

MCI is one of the fastest-growing tech-enabled business services companies in the USA, with a strong call center footprint and operations that extend across multiple countries. We deliver Customer Experience (CX), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), and Anything-as-a-Service (XaaS) cloud technology solutions across a wide range of industries, including healthcare, retail, government, education, telecom, technology e-commerce, and financial services. Our contact centers are powered by both on-site and remote agents, leveraging advanced technologies to enhance customer journeys, drive scalability and reduce costs.

At MCI we are committed to fostering an environment where professionals can build meaningful careers, access continuous learning and development opportunities and contribute to the success of a globally expanding, industry-leading organization.

This position supports customer service, technical support, and customer sales interactions. This role requires you to interact with hundreds of customers each week across the country to resolve support issues, sell new products and services, and ensure best in class customer experience. In addition to being the best in the business when it comes to customer interactions, you will need to be confident, fully engaged, a team player, and dedicated to bringing a positive and enthusiastic outlook to work each day.

To be considered for this role, you must complete a full application on our company careers page, including all screening questions and a brief pre-employment test.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

Key Responsibilities:

  • Listen to customers, understand their needs, and resolve customer issues
  • Utilize systems and technology to complete account management tasks
  • Recognize sales opportunity and apply sales skills to upgrade
  • Explain and position the products and processes with customers
  • Appropriately escalate customer dissatisfaction with managerial team
  • Ensure first call resolution through problems solving and effective call handling

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS

WONDER IF YOU ARE A GOOD FIT FOR THIS POSITION?

MCI provides all new employees with world-class training, so all positive, driven, and confident applicants are encouraged to apply. Ideal candidates for this position are highly motivated, energetic, and dedicated.

Qualifications

  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Excellent organizational, written, and oral communication skills
  • The ability to type swiftly and accurately (20+ words a minute)
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)
  • Basic understanding of Windows operating system
  • Highly reliable with the ability to maintain regular attendance and punctuality
  • The ability to evaluate, troubleshoot, and follow-up on customer issues
  • An aptitude for conflict resolution, problem solving and negotiation
  • Must be customer service oriented (empathetic, responsive, patient, and conscientious)
  • Ability to multi-task, stay focused and self-manage
  • Strong team orientation and customer focus
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where change and ambiguity prevalent
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with your team and customers

ABOUT MCI (PARENT COMPANY)

MCI helps customers take on their CX and DX challenges differently, creating industry-leading solutions that deliver exceptional experiences and drive optimal performance. MCI assists companies with business process outsourcing, staff augmentation, contact center customer services, and IT Services needs by providing general and specialized hosting, software, staff, and services.In 2019, Marlowe Companies Inc. (MCI) was named by Inc. Magazine as Iowa's Fastest Growing Company in the State of Iowa and was named the 452nd Fastest Growing Privately Company in the USA, making the coveted top 500 for the first time. MCI's subsidiaries had previously made Inc. Magazine's List of Fastest-Growing Companies 15 times, respectively. MCI has ten business process outsourcing service delivery facilities in Georgia, Florida, Texas, New Mexico, California, Kansas, Nova Scotia, South Africa, and the Philippines. Driving modernization through digitalization, MCI ensures clients do more for less. MCI is the holding company for a diverse lineup of tech-enabled business services operating companies. MCI organically grows, acquires, and operates companies that have synergistic products and services portfolios, including but not limited to Automated Contact Center Solutions (ACCS), customer contact management, IT Services (IT Schedule 70), and Temporary and Administrative Professional Staffing (TAPS Schedule 736), Business Process Management (BPM), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Claims Processing, Collections, Customer Experience Provider (CXP), Customer Service, Digital Experience Provider (DXP), Account Receivables Management (ARM), Application Software Development, Managed Services, and Technology Services, to mid-market, Federal & enterprise partners. MCI now employs 10,000+ talented individuals with 150+ diverse North American client partners across the following MCI brands: MCI BPO, MCI BPOaaS, MarketForce, GravisApps, Gravis Marketing, MarchEast, Mass Markets, MCI Federal Services (MFS), OnBrand24, The Sydney Call Center, Valor Intelligent Processing (VIP), BYC Aqua, EastWest BPO, TeleTechnology, and Vinculum.

WANT AN EMPLOYER THAT VALUES YOUR CONTRIBUTION?

At MCI, we believe that your hard work deserves recognition and reward. Our compensation and benefits packages are designed to be competitive and to grow with you over time. Starting compensation is based on experience, and we offer a variety of benefits and incentives to support and reward our team members.

What You Can Expect from MCI:

We understand the importance of balance and support, which is why we offer a variety of benefits and incentives that go beyond a paycheck. Our team members enjoy:

  • Paid Time Off: Earn PTO and paid holidays to take the time you need.
  • Incentives & Rewards: Participate in daily, weekly, and monthly contests that include cash bonuses and prizes ranging from electronics to dream vacations and sometimes even cars!

  • Career Growth: With a focus on internal promotions, employees enjoy significant advancement opportunities.

MCI takes pride in tailoring our offerings to fit the needs of our diverse team across subsidiaries and locations. While specific benefits and incentives may vary by geography, the core of our commitment remains the same: rewarding effort, providing growth opportunities, and creating an environment where every employee feels valued.

If you’re ready to join a company that recognizes your contributions and supports your growth, MCI is the place for you. Apply today!

This job operates in a professional office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be largely sedentary and will be required to sit/stand for long periods while using a computer and telephone headset. The employee will be regularly required to operate a computer and other office equipment, including a phone, copier, and printer. The employee may occasionally be required to move about the office to accomplish tasks; reach in any direction; raise or lower objects, move objects from place to place, hold onto objects, and move or exert force up to forty (40) pounds.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), it is the policy of MCI and its affiliates to provide reasonable accommodations when requested by a qualified applicant or employee with a disability unless such accommodations would cause undue hardship. At MCI and its subsidiaries, we embrace differences and believe diversity benefits our employees, company, customers, and community. All aspects of employment at MCI are based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. MCI maintains a work environment free from discrimination, where employees are treated with dignity and respect. All employees are responsible for fulfilling MCI's commitment to a diverse and equal-opportunity work environment.

MCI does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. MCI will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements.

MCI will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, benefits, social and recreational programs, and discipline. In addition, MCI's policy is to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees with protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where an employee works.

raw.description:
COUNSEL OPPORTUNITY

COUNSEL – eDiscovery & Information Governance

Redgrave LLP is seeking a Counsel with 5–10 years of experience leading eDiscovery workstreams in complex litigation and investigations. This position is fully remote, with some travel expected; an active license may be required in a state where the Firm has an office.This role partners with clients and merits counsel to deliver practical, defensible discovery strategy at the intersection of eDiscovery, information governance, and data privacy.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will take ownership of discovery-focused workstreams, draft sophisticated written work product, and help teams execute efficient, defensible solutions. You will be client-facing and will collaborate directly with merits counsel, co-counsel, experts, and internal teams.

Responsibilities

  • Lead eDiscovery and information-governance workstreams in complex litigation and investigations.
  • Draft and review discovery and governance work product, including legal memoranda, correspondence, protective orders, ESI agreements, motions, playbook components, and defensibility memoranda.
  • Prepare outlines and talking points for client meetings, custodian interviews, meet-and-confers, and motion hearings.
  • Coordinate with merits counsel, co-counsel, and experts; support expert task/matter management and preparation for oral testimony as needed.
  • Provide practical legal advice to Firm teams; monitor emerging law and support training/policy development.
  • Coach and mentor junior team members; contribute to cohesive, high-performing teams.
  • Support thought leadership and practice development initiatives; identify opportunities to expand client relationships.

Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) and active U.S. bar admission (additional admissions obtained as needed).
  • 5–10 years of experience managing eDiscovery in complex litigation and investigations.
  • Excellent legal writing and research skills; proven ability to draft complex discovery documents and memoranda.
  • Strong project leadership and client-facing communication skills; comfort working directly with merits counsel and co-counsel.
  • Technology-forward mindset and proficiency with Microsoft Office; ability to quickly learn and leverage litigation support tools.
  • Willingness to travel as needed (including international travel depending on assignment).

Preferred

  • Experience advising on information governance and/or data privacy issues in the litigation/investigation context.
  • Experience developing defensibility positions or playbooks; participation in industry organizations and thought leadership.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Occasionally lifts objects weighing up to 10 pounds
  • Frequently reaches and grasps with arms and hands; occasionally stoops and bends; must have manual dexterity
  • Ability to closely examine and inspect materials
  • Ability to identify and distinguish colors
  • Ability to travel as needed
  • Frequently uses a keyboard to enter or transform words or data
  • Work is generally performed in a remote office environment with an occasional requirement to work in a normal office environment

BENEFITS

Redgrave LLP is committed to supporting our employees and ensuring their needs are met beyond the workplace. We offer a flexible portfolio of benefits and services, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan, additional benefits to help you prepare for retirement, free access to Employee Assistance Programs, and other programs designed to help you and your family stay healthy, feel secure, and enjoy a positive work/life balance.

Please Note:

This job description sets forth the job’s principal duties, responsibilities, and requirements; however, it should not be construed as an exhaustive statement. Unless they begin with the word “may,” the essential duties, tasks, and responsibilities described above are “essential functions” of the job, as defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act.

Redgrave LLP is an Equal Opportunity Employer

raw.description:
We are one of the fastest-growing private youth sports operators in the GTA and Florida. We delivery high-quality, structured sports programming across multiple locations, with a focus on fun, skills development, and exceptional customer experiences.

This is an entry-level role for someone who has foundational knowledge of email or digital marketing and wants to develop deep expertise in lifecycle campaigns, automation, and data-driven optimization. You will work side by side with the Director of Marketing, building real skills in platforms like Twilio and SendGrid while contributing to campaigns that directly impact customer acquisition and retention.

If you are analytical, curious, detail-oriented, and excited about how data and messaging come together to drive results — we want to meet you.

WHY JOIN US

We are a growing company in the sports industry, and our marketing team is at the core of our expansion. This role is an opportunity to go beyond sending emails — you will learn the strategy, the technology, and the data behind lifecycle marketing at a company that moves fast and values results.

  • Mentorship from experienced marketers and direct access to senior leadership.
  • Hands-on work with enterprise platforms (Twilio, SendGrid) from day one.
  • A culture that rewards curiosity, precision, and ownership.
  • Flexible remote or hybrid work arrangement.
  • A real growth path toward a full Lifecycle Marketing Specialist or Marketing Analyst role.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Campaign Execution & Support

  • Assist in building, scheduling, QAing, and launching email and SMS campaigns using Twilio and SendGrid under senior supervision.
  • Help set up and QA automated lifecycle flows including onboarding sequences, re-engagement campaigns, retention triggers, and other lifecycle marketing initiatives.
  • Support the management of audience lists, segmentation criteria, suppression files, and workflow documentation.
  • Assist in preparing and formatting email templates in collaboration with the design team.
  • Coordinate campaign timelines, internal deliverables, and marketing calendars to ensure campaigns launch on schedule.
  • Maintain organized libraries of marketing assets, templates, and campaign documentation.

Testing & Performance Tracking

  • Support A/B test setup and help document results for subject lines, CTAs, and content variants.
  • Assist with campaign testing, tracking, and reporting across email and SMS channels.
  • Compile and maintain performance reports tracking key metrics including open rates, click-through rates, conversions, engagement, and unsubscribes.
  • Assist in identifying trends in campaign data and flagging opportunities for optimization and process improvements.

Compliance & Operations

  • Help ensure all campaigns comply with applicable regulations including CASL, CAN-SPAM, and GDPR.
  • Assist with list hygiene tasks including managing bounces, opt-outs, and suppression lists.
  • Maintain documentation of campaign workflows, platform settings, operational processes, and process guides.
  • Support ongoing improvements to marketing processes and operational workflows.

Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Director of Marketing and senior team members to align on campaign priorities and goals.
  • Coordinate with marketing, design, and content teams to ensure campaigns are executed accurately, assets are delivered on time, and messaging remains on brand.
  • Participate in team meetings, contribute ideas, and ask questions.

Requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Up to 1–2 years of experience in email marketing, digital marketing, or related roles (internships and relevant coursework count).
  • Basic familiarity with email marketing concepts: deliverability, segmentation, open rates, click-through rates.
  • Comfortable working with data and digital tools; not afraid of dashboards or spreadsheets.
  • Strong attention to detail: you notice what others miss and take quality seriously.
  • Great written communication skills in English.
  • Eagerness to learn marketing platforms and grow into a technical marketing role.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken). Spanish is a strong asset.

PREFERRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Any hands-on experience with an email platform (Mailchimp, HubSpot, Klaviyo, SendGrid, or similar).
  • Exposure to SMS marketing or basic understanding of how SMS campaigns work.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing concepts.
  • Basic HTML knowledge or willingness to learn email templating.
  • Studies or coursework in marketing, communications, business, or related fields.
  • Any experience in digital, tech, or startup environments.

Benefits

Compensation: $800-1200 USD p/m
